response.reason: The cited clause, Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Art. 22(1), establishes the requirement for quantitative ingredient declarations (QUID) when certain conditions are met (such as the ingredient appearing in the name of the food). However, it does not establish the requirement for a legal, customary, or descriptive name for the food; that requirement is found elsewhere in the regulation (specifically, Article 17). Therefore, while the clause supports the QUID aspect of the verdict, it is insufficient as a citation for the naming requirement.
